original_statement: For Kc>0 verify f=sinh(sqrt(Kc)s)/sqrt(Kc), f(0)=0, fprime(0)=1, fsecond=Kc f and the comparison integral identity; give the Kc=0 limit separately.

definitions.Kc: Real Kc>0 hyperbolic branch, positive sqrt; inverse-length-squared. Separately Kc=0 flat branch.
definitions.s: Real affine length s>=0; integration variable t in [0,s].
definitions.f: f(Kc,s)=sinh(sqrt(Kc)*s)/sqrt(Kc) for Kc>0; f(0,s)=s defined as continuous extension to be justified
definitions.comparison_integral_target: Kc * integral_0^s (s-t)*f(Kc,t) dt = f(Kc,s)-s; derive, do not assume
definitions.units: s,t,f length; Kc inverse-length-squared; sqrt(Kc)*s dimensionless; fprime dimensionless,fsecond inverse-length.
definitions.zero_branch: At Kc=0 f0(s)=s, f0(0)=0,f0prime(0)=1,f0second=0, integral identity 0=0; justify fixed-s right Kc→0+ limit. No division by Kc on zero branch.
definitions.series_if_used: Coefficient formula/recurrence may support independent exact algebra; finitely many coefficients do not prove the full analytic function or inequality
definitions.domains: All s>=0,Kc>0; no sampled-only universal identities, no arbitrary bound/target premises
